{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|gr1= Environment

|descr= Returns the current wind azimuth.

|s1= [[windDir]]

|r1= [[Number]] - azimuth

|x1= <sqf>
if (windDir < 45 || windDir > 315) then {
	hint "I feel a southern wind"; // wind going from South to North
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[wind]] [[setWindDir]] [[setWindStr]] [[setWindForce]]
}}
